P.name: Staggering Blow
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nautilus' '''{{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|14 + (116-14)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|root}} the target for {{pp|changedisplay=true|0.75 to 1.5 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds.
P.description2: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

Q.name: Dredge Line
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' hurls his anchor in the target direction that stops on the first enemy or terrain hit.
Q.description2: If the anchor hits an enemy, it deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for {{fd|1.15}} seconds, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second, and {{tip|airborne|drags}} them toward '''Nautilus''' while he also {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward them, both over {{fd|0.9}} seconds.
Q.description3: If the anchor hits terrain, '''Nautilus''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to that location and 50% of ''Dredge Line's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|mana|{{as|mana cost}}}} are refunded.
Q.description4: '''''Nautilus''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Dredge Line is in flight. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

W.name: Titan's Wrath
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 6 seconds, and while it holds, his {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply ''Pain of Wrath'' to the target and enemies near them.
W.description2: {{sbc|Pain of Wrath:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} over time, half dealt immediately and the other half dealt after {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Instance|{{ap|30/2 to 70/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40/2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: ''Titan's Wrath {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nautilus' ''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Riptide
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' sends three waves of explosions that radiate from him {{tt|over {{fd|0.561}} seconds|See notes}}. Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 50% against those hit by subsequent waves beyond the first, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|55*0.5 to 195*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.5}}% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|55*2 to 195*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
E.description2: The first hit against {{tip|monsters}} deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

R.name: Depth Charge
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nautilus''' sends out a [[File:Depth Charge 2.png|20px|link=]] ''Depth Charge'' that chases the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, accelerating over time and creating eruptions every {{rutngt|0.25}} in its wake that also briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of the area. Enemies hit by the eruptions are dealt {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|125 to 225}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
R.description2: Upon reaching the primary target, the ''Depth Charge'' erupts a final time at their location. The primary target takes increased damage, is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration, and {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for a modified duration.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Damage|{{ap|150 to 400}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Knock Up Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
